the following questions: (1) How to design an end-to-end deep network for exemplar-based color image generation? (2) How to automatically recommend the reference images? (3) How to extend to video?

the development of an end-to-end deep learning approach to colorization.

the proposed approach is a novel deep exemplar-based colorizer, which can colorize an input grayscale image by using a reference image.
our approach is a robust and generalizable method that is easy to use and produces results that are comparable to or better than other methods.
the proposed approach is able to produce high-quality colorization results with minimal user intervention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel deep learning approach to exemplar-based color image generation.
we propose the first end-to-end exemplar-based colorizing network that learns how to select and propagate colors, and we demonstrate the first fully-automated video colorization system.
our method can automatically color a gray-scale image by using the reference image, and it can be used to color a video.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning is a powerful tool for image processing and computer vision tasks, even for those that are traditionally solved by hand-crafted rules.
the deep exemplar-based coloriztion approach can achieve better results than previous exemplar-based colorizers, and it is also much faster than previous learning-based colorizers.
deep learning provides a powerful framework to solve complex image processing tasks, such as image colorization, with minimal human intervention and supervision.
